lines.text: In the fortieth year, Moses began to explain the law east of the Jordan in the land of Moab.
At Horeb the LORD told Israel they had stayed long enough and to enter the land sworn to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
Moses said he could not carry the burden alone, because the LORD had made the people as numerous as the sands.
Moses told the people to choose wise men from each tribe, and he appointed them as commanders of thousands, hundreds, fifties, and twelves.
Moses charged the judges to show no partiality and to bring any case too difficult for them to him.
